title: Octavius: Mitigating Task Interference in MLLMs via LoRA-MoE

layout.note: A wide dashed architecture box at the top is the hub. Two cards (2D Detection, 3D Captioning) and a column of task pills hang below it, two cards (2D Captioning, 3D VQA) are stacked on its right edge; inside the hub the model reads top-down: inputs, prompt parts, token strip, LLM row, output strip.

lesson: Draw the architecture as a dashed hub and hang one colour-keyed, tabbed card per task off its edges, each card pairing a real input with question and response text whose object words are coloured like the boxes in the picture. Keep the frozen/trainable key (snowflake, flame) inside the hub.
